body:
Founder real-time: 'ensure editor binaries for windows linux and mac are released in artifacts on parena on release' + 'move parena from pre release releases to regular releases on auto releases'. Both now real and verified live at https://github.com/emilyspringerton/PARENA/releases/tag/v0.69.0 (prerelease: false), with all 4 real assets attached: parena compiler + editor-demo-linux-x86_64.tar.gz + editor-demo-windows-x86_64.zip + editor-demo-macos.tar.gz. Architecture: parena compiler generates editor-demo's combined C source once (Linux, the only platform it runs on), then a new build_editor_windows job (MSYS2/MinGW64, mirroring PITVIPER's own proven precedent) and a new build_editor_macos job (Homebrew SDL2/SDL2_ttf) compile it NATIVELY on each real platform; release logic split into its own job gated on all three builds succeeding; --prerelease dropped from gh release create. Took 5 real CI iterations to go fully green, each one a real bug found via the actual live runner (not guessed): (1) Windows SDL2main link (undefined reference to WinMain -- needs -lmingw32 -lSDL2main -lSDL2), (2) macOS SDL_ttf.h's own internal unqualified #include "SDL.h" needing an extra -I.../include/SDL2, (3) a real, general emit.c gap -- exhaustive-but-unprovable-to-C match lowering left __match_result_N genuinely uninitialized on some paths, only Clang's -Wsometimes-uninitialized caught it (fixed at the root: = {0}, valid C99 for any decl_type), (4)+(5) generated enum-variant AND defstruct _new constructors as unused static inline functions, which GCC tolerates and Clang doesn't (fixed: __attribute__((unused)) at both emission sites). Also depended on the earlier Windows-portability fix (Apple #16235, runtime/parena_runtime.h #ifndef _WIN32 guards + portable contains-ci?). Zero regressions at every step: full local suite (336 tests) + domain4/5/multifile + sdl2/editor/render/io suites + editor-demo-smoke + bazel build/test, verified after every single commit. Commits: 5b80f97/c6edd99/82348e2/4a8ea90/3fb25e8.

⚓ ☃
title: Real cross-platform editor-demo release binaries + regular (non-prerelease) auto-releases
